resorts.name: Eischoll
resorts.comments:
Eischoll can look back on an eventful and at the same time impressive 60-year winter sports history. The transport facilities of the Eischoll Augstbord region consist of a chair lift, a ski lift and a beginner's lift.
The total of 15 km of slopes offer something for all winter sports enthusiasts. Everyone can learn to ski, carve or board on our pistes or let off steam with their winter sports equipment.
Our pistes are not overcrowded and you can still experience pure driving fun with us.
The ski run to the village is open throughout the winter and at the valley station of the chairlift, you also benefit from free parking.
There is also a 3 km long toboggan run from the Strygge to the village. You can also increase your sledding pleasure on a Ghosky sled. These special sleds can be hired at the valley station of the chairlift.
Every Friday and Saturday evening you can also ski at night in Eischoll.

resorts.name: Mythenregion
resorts.comments:
The Mythenregion is located in the heart of Central Switzerland and can be easily reached from Zug, Lucerne, Zurich or the canton of Aargau in 30-60 minutes. The ski area offers 50 kilometres of pistes, a unique freestyle park, the Kabi children's park and various magic carpets for the youngest guests. The variety of leisure activities in the family ski area is great. Cool toboggan runs, varied snowshoe trails, winter hiking trails and a cross-country ski trail - there is bound to be something for everyone. And for your well-being, the hosts of our cosy restaurants and piste bars look forward to your visit. A warm welcome to the Mythenregion.
